archetype: ARCHETYPE 5 (Luxury) mixed with ARCHETYPE 7 (Vibrant Play) - Asian Gaming Festive

typography.headings: System Chinese Fonts (PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei) or Noto Sans SC, bold and dense (font-black or font-bold). Tracking tight.

mobile_shell.strategy: Fixed Top Header + Fixed Bottom Tab Bar
mobile_shell.header: Fixed top-0, w-full, h-14, bg-[#D81E2C], text-white, z-50. Center brand text '得胜28'. Omit all desktop buttons (App download/PC/CS).
mobile_shell.bottom_tab_bar: Fixed bottom-0, w-full, h-16, bg-white, border-t border-gray-100, z-50, shadow-[0_-4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]. 5 items: 首页, 活动, 游戏乐园 (center), 兑换, 会员中心.
mobile_shell.center_fab: The center '游戏乐园' tab must be elevated. Use absolute positioning (bottom-4 or top-[-20px] inside the tab) with a larger circular background, red gradient, and glowing shadow.
mobile_shell.content_area: All page containers must have pt-14 and pb-20 to prevent content clipping under fixed bars.

home_page.hero_carousel: w-full h-40 mt-2 px-2 rounded-xl overflow-hidden
home_page.quick_icons: grid grid-cols-5 gap-2 px-2 mt-4. Circular icons with gradient bg, text-xs below.
home_page.marquee: h-8 mx-2 mt-3 bg-red-50 text-red-600 rounded-full flex items-center px-3 text-sm. Include a speaker icon.
home_page.left_rail: w-1/4 flex flex-col gap-1. Active item is white with a red left-border indicator. Inactive is transparent.
home_page.right_cards: w-3/4 flex flex-col gap-3. Stacked cards (Canada, Taiwan, Singapore, Macau). Cards have bg-[#FFF8E7], rounded-lg, p-3, relative overflow-hidden.
home_page.floating_packet: fixed right-4 bottom-24 z-40 w-16 h-16 animate-bounce. Red packet image with a live countdown text-xs underneath.

layouts.activities_page: Cards with rich red-gold gradients, generous p-4 spacing.
layouts.rankings_page: Top 3 podium layout (1st place larger, gold border; 2nd silver; 3rd bronze). Followed by a vertical list.
layouts.shop_page: 2-column grid on mobile (grid-cols-2). Clear '兑换' (Exchange) CTA buttons in primary red.
layouts.user_center_page: Top half red gradient background extending behind a white overlapping profile card (negative margin technique). Stacked options list below.

desktop_preservation_strategy: CRITICAL: The problem statement demands desktop stays exactly as-is. For major structural changes (like the Home layout or the new Mobile Header/TabBar), the main agent MUST wrap the new mobile UI in `<div className='block md:hidden'>` and wrap the existing desktop UI in `<div className='hidden md:block'>`. Do NOT override global desktop styles.

visual_enhancers.borders: Minimal. Use soft shadows `shadow-sm` and colored subtle borders `border-red-100`.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Active states on tabs should have a slight scale transform. Press states on cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise on the red header is optional. Rich gradients for gold elements (`bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FCEABB] to-[#F5A623]`).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gold is dark brown (#3E2723), not white.
accessibility.test_ids: MUST add `data-testid` to all navigation items, buttons, and clickable cards.

gold_beans.description: Gold coins proxy for points/gold beans

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not break existing desktop layouts. Use `block md:hidden` for mobile-only wrappers and `hidden md:block` for existing desktop wrappers where layouts diverge significantly.
Do not use transparent header backgrounds if content scrolls under it.
Do not use generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Make the UI feel like a premium Asian mobile app (like Alipay/WeChat mini-programs layout).
Use Lucide-react for standard icons. Where a custom 'Gold Bean' is required, use the existing asset or provided coin image.
Ensure the floating red packet has a `z-index` higher than main content but lower than modals.
Use sonner for any toast messages (e.g., clicking 立即充提/每日任务 which are coming-soon/toasts).
Center elevate the '游戏乐园' in the bottom tab bar accurately using absolute positioning and a drop shadow.
